topic: Choosing what belongs in an exhibition
grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: Choosing what belongs in an exhibition
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立盲听答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
transcript:
Curator: We have room for eighteen sound clips in the town exhibition. How did you select them?
Eli: I chose recordings with contrasting activities: a market, a workshop, a garden and several others. It is a curated selection, not a representative sample.
Curator: Put that on the introductory label. What information accompanies each file?
Eli: A recording date, a broad location and the microphone model. Exact home addresses are excluded.
Curator: Have the original recordings survived the editing?
Eli: Yes. The exhibition uses shorter copies, but the original file remains in the archive. A removed pause might matter to someone studying the rhythm of an activity.
Curator: One label says the market is always noisy. Can a single clip show that?
Eli: No. It could include an unusual delivery. I will change the label to describe what happened during this recording, rather than a typical day.
Curator: And identifiable speech?
Eli: We obtained consent for two short interviews. A private conversation beside a cafe table has been removed. A description of that setting will appear instead.
Curator: When do we check the final labels?
Eli: On Tuesday, before the public opening on Friday. We will compare the labels with the raw recording notes, so the exhibition does not imply that we measured more than we did.

questions.prompt: How many clips is there room for in the exhibition?
questions.explanation: 原文说有容纳eighteen段录音的空间；这是容量，不把它推断为最终必定展出的数量。 数量允许本题列出的等值数字写法；单位接受明确列出的英美拼写。

questions.prompt: What does the selection aim to illustrate?
options: An equal sample of all streets.
The normal noise level of every area.
questions.explanation: 依据原文“recordings with contrasting activities”。正确项保持了原文的范围和关系，其余项改动了该信息。

questions.prompt: Which equipment detail accompanies each recording?
questions.explanation: 依据原文“the microphone model.”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。

questions.prompt: What has been preserved beside edited copies?
questions.explanation: 依据原文“the original file remains in the archive.”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。
questions.evidence: the original file remains in the archive.

questions.prompt: Why is the market label being revised?
options: One recording cannot establish a usual pattern.
The market recording contains no sound.
Every day at the market is identical.
The archive refuses to describe locations.
answers: One recording cannot establish a usual pattern.
questions.explanation: 依据原文“rather than a typical day.”。正确项保持了原文的范围和关系，其余项改动了该信息。

options: A louder recording of the same speakers.
A written description of its setting.
answers: A written description of its setting.

questions.evidence: A description of that setting will appear instead.

questions.explanation: 依据原文“On Tuesday, before the public opening on Friday.”。答案按原文填写，保留限定范围。
questions.evidence: On Tuesday, before the public opening on Friday.

grammar.title: 结论强度与情态动词
grammar.explanation: may/could 表示可能；must 表示这里给出的强制规则。根据句中明确说明的证据或规则作答，不把小样本可能性改成普遍必然。
grammar.example: It could include an unusual delivery.

questions.prompt: The effect _____ vary; the sample is too small to be certain. （只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: may/could 表示可能；must 表示这里给出的强制规则。根据句中明确说明的证据或规则作答，不把小样本可能性改成普遍必然。 本句为：The effect may vary; the sample is too small to be certain.
questions.evidence: The effect may vary; the sample is too small to be certain.

transfer.writing: Write an evidence-based paragraph of 120–160 words about creating a public exhibition. State one claim, support it with a relevant example, acknowledge a limitation, and explain what further evidence would change your conclusion. Use a new example; do not copy the passage.
